description:
SOBRE A EMPRESA

Desde 2013 no mercado a RCX é reconhecida por satisfazer efetivamente as necessidades dos seus clientes, com soluções inovadoras e personalizadas, sejam elas nas áreas de comunicação corporativa, redes de computadores, contact center, operações e inteligência. Nossa missão é criar, implantar e manter soluções inovadoras que impulsionem resultados significativos. Valorizamos o compromisso com a construção de uma sociedade melhor, promovendo iniciativas individuais e um ambiente de trabalho jovem, produtivo, inovador e de relacionamento leve. Se você se identifica com esses valores e busca fazer parte de uma equipe que busca constantemente a excelência, essa oportunidade é para você.

SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Recursos Humanos para integrar nosso time! Este profissional será responsável por coordenar processos de recrutamento e seleção, elaborar contratos, promover iniciativas de endomarketing e organizar programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento. Além disso, terá um papel estratégico na condução de entrevistas de desligamento, sessões de feedback one-on-one e ações que fortaleçam nossa cultura e engajamento dos colaboradores.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  1. Recrutamento e Seleção:
    • Coordenação do processo de recrutamento e seleção, do início ao fim, desde a solicitação de vagas até o envio de proposta detalhada da oportunidade de trabalho.
    • Condução de entrevistas, avaliação de candidatos e seleção dos melhores talentos para atender às necessidades da empresa.
  2. Gestão de Contratos:
    • Responsável pelo pedido e elaboração de contratos, garantindo o cumprimento das políticas e regulamentos da empresa.
    • Manutenção de registros organizados de todos os contratos e documentação relacionada.
    • Monitoramento de prazos e datas importantes, garantindo a renovação ou elaboração de novos contratos conforme necessário.
  3. Endomarketing:
    • Planejamento e execução de iniciativas de endomarketing para promover a cultura organizacional, o engajamento dos funcionários e a construção de uma marca empregadora forte.
    • Organização de eventos de Endomarketing, como Happy Hours mensais, visando fortalecer os laços entre os colaboradores e promover um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo.
  4. Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:
    • Planejamento e execução de programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento para os colaboradores, visando aprimorar suas habilidades e competências profissionais.
    • Realização de reuniões de integração com novos colaboradores, apresentando a empresa, sua cultura organizacional, equipe e instalações, para facilitar a integração e o engajamento desde o início de sua jornada na empresa.
  5. Gestão de Desligamento:
    • Condução de entrevistas de desligamento com colaboradores que estão deixando a empresa, buscando entender suas experiências e fornecer feedback construtivo para promover melhorias.
    • Análise dos insights obtidos nas entrevistas de desligamento para identificar áreas de oportunidade e implementar mudanças que contribuam para o aprimoramento contínuo da empresa.
  6. Feedback One-on-One:
    • Realização de sessões individuais de feedback com todos os colaboradores da empresa para entender sua satisfação, preocupações e sugestões relacionadas ao ambiente de trabalho e às práticas de gestão de pessoas.
    • Fornecimento de um espaço seguro e confidencial para os colaboradores expressarem suas opiniões e sentimentos, visando promover a transparência, a confiança e o engajamento dentro da equipe.
    • Análise e compilação dos insights obtidos durante as sessões de feedback para identificar tendências, áreas de melhoria e oportunidades de desenvolvimento para a empresa e sua equipe.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Modelo de trabalho: híbrido (com 3 dias presenciais);
  • Sede localizada em Porto Alegre/RS;
  • DayOff no mês de aniversário;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e inovador.

PERFIL DESEJADO

  • Experiência comprovada em recrutamento e seleção, treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de seleção por competências;
  • Habilidade de ouvir e compreender os colaboradores, promovendo um ambiente de confiança;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e iniciativas simultaneamente;
  • Alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais para fortalecer a cultura e engajar a equipe.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Pós-graduação em áreas como Psicologia Organizacional, Gestão de Pessoas ou afins;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes ágeis.

REMUNERAÇÃO

A combinar.

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.
If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

The Role:
We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Trial Manager in the Biotech Division, aligned with therapeutic areas such as General Medicine (NASH), Rare Diseases, or Oncology , to join our dynamic and diverse team. As a Clinical Trial Manager at ICON, you will lead global clinical trials, interpret complex medical data, and contribute to the development of groundbreaking treatments and therapies.

What you will be doing:

  • Leading and managing all aspects of global clinical trial activities, from planning and execution to close-out.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop trial protocols, study plans, and strategies.
  • Monitoring trial progress to ensure adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Managing relationships with third-party vendors, including selection, oversight, and performance evaluation.
  • Providing leadership, guidance, and mentorship to project teams, fostering effective communication and problem-solving.
  • Participating in sponsor meetings, investigator meetings, and bid defense meetings as a key contributor.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

Experience:

  • Minimum 4.5 years of experience for consideration at the Senior CTM level.
  • Global trial management experience is required, with a strong focus on the US and Canada.
  • Experience working with the Advarra Ethics Committee is highly desirable.
  • At least 3+ years of monitoring experience is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience managing all trial components (from start-up to database lock) is preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a health, life sciences, or other relevant field, required.

Skills:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex or global clinical trials.
  • Experience in coaching and mentoring other CTMs, leading teams, and contributing to departmental initiatives.
  • Strong proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required.
  • For candidates based in Brazil, comfort with Spanish is an advantage.

*Please submit CV/Resume in English.*

Benefits of Working in ICON:
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

We offer very competitive salary packages. And to keep them competitive, we regularly benchmark them against our competitors. Our annual bonuses reflect delivery of performance goals – both ours and yours.
We also provide a range of health-related benefits to employees and their families and offer competitive retirement plans – and related benefits such as life assurance – so you can save and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
But beyond the competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, you’ll benefit from an environment where you are encouraged to fulfil your sense of purpose and drive lasting change.

O que faz um assistente de RH?

Um Assistente de recursos humanos desempenha uma série de atividades para garantir o bom funcionamento da área de RH e o desenvolvimento adequado dos colaboradores.

Uma das principais atividades de um assistente de recursos humanos é o recrutamento e seleção de novos talentos. Eles trabalham em conjunto com os gestores para identificar as necessidades de contratação e, em seguida, elaboram estratégias para atrair candidatos qualificados.

Isso envolve a redação e divulgação de vagas, triagem de currículos, condução de entrevistas e aplicação de testes específicos. O objetivo é encontrar os candidatos mais adequados para preencher as vagas disponíveis.

Além disso, os assistentes de RH cuidam do processo de integração dos novos funcionários, preparando materiais de boas-vindas, realizando treinamentos introdutórios e fornecendo todas as informações necessárias para que os novos colaboradores se sintam acolhidos.

Outra responsabilidade importante é o gerenciamento dos benefícios e compensações oferecidos aos funcionários. Os assistentes de RH trabalham para garantir que os benefícios sejam adequados e competitivos, além de administrar os planos de saúde, programas de incentivo e outras vantagens oferecidas pela empresa.

Os assistentes de recursos humanos também desempenham um papel fundamental na gestão do clima organizacional, promovendo ações para fortalecer a cultura da empresa, como programas de reconhecimento e atividades de integração. Eles lidam com conflitos entre colaboradores e buscam soluções que promovam um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

No dia a dia, os assistentes de RH podem realizar tarefas relacionadas à administração de pessoal, como a elaboração de contratos de trabalho e o controle de registros dos funcionários. Eles também podem ser responsáveis pela elaboração e execução de programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento.

Além disso, os assistentes de recursos humanos atuam como parceiros estratégicos dos gestores, fornecendo suporte na gestão de desempenho e auxiliando no estabelecimento de metas.

Quais são as principais habilidades do Assistente de RH?

description:
Job description

O Hospital VFP é tido como referência na medicina veterinária intensiva no quesito qualidade e inovação no Brasil e, em 2024, novas unidades próprias e franqueadas serão inauguradas.

Nosso hospital vive sob a cultura de aprendizagem, com valorização de stakeholders e com as melhores tecnologias do mercado para que a assistência médica veterinária seja eficiente.

Venha trabalhar conosco!


Main responsibilities

O médico veterinário de atendimento é o primeiro profissional do corpo clínico a ter contato com o tutor e paciente. Sua boa oratória associada ao seu conhecimento e cordialidade são fundamentais para conquistar a confiança do tutor e fazer com que ele se sinta seguro em deixar seu filho de patas sob os cuidados da equipe do hospital. Suas atribuições são:

  1. Prestar o pronto atendimento ao paciente que dá entrada na unidade hospitalar, de acordo com as necessidades assistenciais, respeitando os valores, princípios e os objetivos institucionais.
  2. Criar um ambiente terapêutico em ambulatórios e sala de emergência a fim de proporcionar a reabilitação e o bem-estar do paciente.
  3. Admitir e classificar pacientes em situação de urgência e emergência conforme normas internas estabelecidas, respeitando os valores, princípios e os objetivos institucionais.
  4. Fornecer atendimento rápido e de alta qualidade na admissão do paciente.
  5. Garantir organização e limpeza dos ambulatórios e salas de emergência.

Caso o médico veterinário de atendimento tenha especialidade em áreas sinérgicas com o modelo assistencial, o hospital também fornece treinamentos e concede a oportunidade do profissional participar da equipe de especialistas da unidade.


Requirements and skills

Desejável que o candidato possua 2 anos de experiência na área de atuação, através de residência, programa de aprimoramento, ou pós graduação em clínica médica ou clínica cirúrgica.

O médico veterinário de atendimento precisa estar devidamente preparado e ter conhecimento amplo sobre diversos aspectos, uma vez que cuida de pacientes graves que podem evoluir ao óbito a qualquer momento.

Esse profissional recebe treinamentos teóricos-práticos para se capacitar ao atendimento do paciente grave.

É necessário que o médico veterinário de atendimento tenha conhecimento em clínica geral, abordagem emergencial do paciente grave, além do conhecimento na análise ultrassonográfica (T-FAST, A-FAST), cálculos de infusões contínuas, protocolos de sedoanagelsia, hemogasometria e, principalmente, entender conceitos básicos e avançados de hemodinâmica (macro-hemodinâmica e micro-hemodinâmica).


Additional information

Caso o médico veterinário de prescrição tenha especialidade em áreas sinérgicas com o modelo assistencial, o hospital também fornece treinamentos e concede a oportunidade do profissional participar da equipe de especialistas da unidade.

title: Assistente de Proteção /RR
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, qualificada como Organização da Sociedade Civil de Interesse Público (OSCIP), constituída em 2007 para atuar com iniciativas de promoção do desenvolvimento de pessoas. Cumprindo sua missão de tornar as pessoas em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, a AVSI Brasil implementa projetos sociais construídos a partir de uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário. Nos últimos anos, a Venezuela tem vivido uma forte crise, ocasionando vulnerabilidade social e um contexto de emergência humanitária. A AVSI Brasil integra a resposta federal à emergência humanitária venezuelana da Operação Acolhida, formalizando um Termo de Colaboração com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social (MDS) para atuar em 4 (quatro) centros de acolhida (abrigos) para refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos na cidade de Boa Vista, em Roraima.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Assistente de Proteção atua sob a supervisão do(a) Coordenador(a) de Abrigo e com apoio e monitoramento técnico do(a) Oficial de Proteção Júnior e do(a) Oficial de Proteção Pleno. É sua responsabilidade apoiar na busca ativa e monitoramento de pessoas com necessidades específicas e fazer os devidos referenciamentos à equipe e parceiros da Operação, prestar informações à população atendida sobre a rede de proteção, apoiar ações de proteção baseada na comunidade e monitorar riscos e vulnerabilidades no abrigo.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o(a) Oficial de Proteção Pleno e o(a) Oficial de Proteção Júnior, reportando sobre o trabalho técnico de proteção;
  2. Manter contato direto com as pessoas de interesse para identificar os riscos e as necessidades específicas enfrentados por elas;
  3. Prover atenção e primeiros auxílios psicológicos às pessoas de interesse e/ou suas famílias;
  4. Apoiar na triagem entre novos abrigados de possíveis casos que necessitem de acompanhamento individualizado;
  5. Apoiar o monitoramento e a relatoria de indicadores de maior índice em violação de direitos no abrigo;
  6. Apoiar nos agendamentos com a van da organização, para transporte da população atendida;
  7. Identificar e encaminhar aos parceiros da Operação os casos de saúde que necessitam de apoio;
  8. Apoiar no acompanhamento externo de beneficiários, em ocasiões específicas, sempre que necessário.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados para atuar como a ponte entre os dados e o negócio, transformando informações em insights estratégicos para clientes e projetos. Essa posição tem como propósito principal usar dados para impulsionar inovação e evolução nas nossas entregas, trazendo valor agregado ao negócio.

RESPONSABILIDADES IMPORTANTES

  1. Compreender profundamente nosso modelo de negócios, as necessidades dos clientes e os objetivos dos projetos.
  2. Construir hipóteses e soluções personalizadas com base nas demandas específicas de cada cliente.
  3. Colaborar com Consultores de Negócios na definição de indicadores e construção de relatórios estratégicos.
  4. Desenvolver soluções inovadoras utilizando IA, Machine Learning e novas metodologias de análise de dados.

O QUE SERÁ ESPERADO NO DIA A DIA

  1. Realizar extração, tratamento, análise e interpretação de dados de campanhas e bases internas em alta escala.
  2. Construir e otimizar dashboards e relatórios que entreguem insights claros e acionáveis para diferentes stakeholders.
  3. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para análises em tempo real e batch, integrando diferentes fontes de dados.
  4. Projetar estruturas de banco de dados e implementar processos automatizados para melhorar a eficiência e a padronização do fluxo de dados.
  5. Aplicar análises estatísticas e algoritmos de Machine Learning para identificar padrões, prever tendências e embasar decisões estratégicas.
  6. Processar dados não estruturados em formatos utilizáveis e garantir a qualidade das análises entregues.
  7. Apoiar consultores de negócios e equipes multidisciplinares na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, alinhando entregas aos objetivos estratégicos dos clientes.
  8. Preparar relatórios gerenciais com métricas chave de desempenho (KPIs) para monitoramento de campanhas e tomadas de decisão.
  9. Participar de reuniões com clientes para mapear necessidades de dados e propor soluções tecnológicas inovadoras.

REQUISITOS

  • Proficiência em Python com foco em bibliotecas para análise de dados, como Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, e capacidade de desenvolver scripts eficientes para manipulação e visualização de dados.
  • Bancos de Dados: Habilidade para escrever consultas SQL complexas para operações de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga) em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.). Conhecimento em bancos não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB) e estruturação de dados no contexto de projetos de BI.
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios interativos com ferramentas como Tableau e Power BI, ou utilizando bibliotecas Python voltadas para visualização.
  • Estatística e Matemática: Entendimento avançado de conceitos estatísticos, como testes de hipóteses, análise de variância e modelagem preditiva. Familiaridade com probabilidade e álgebra linear para dar suporte às análises preditivas e exploratórias.
  • Machine Learning: Experiência prática com algoritmos básicos de aprendizado de máquina, incluindo regressão, classificação e clustering, com capacidade de implementar esses modelos em Python.
  • Big Data: Conhecimento em plataformas de armazenamento e processamento de dados como Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, ou sistemas on-premise (Hadoop, Spark). Habilidade em trabalhar com ferramentas para gerenciar grandes conjuntos de dados em tempo real ou em lote.

About the role

We are hiring an experienced data analyst to partner closely with the marketing team, with a focus on attribution.

Tremendous values data as a first-class citizen and believes insights unlock significant growth. You will collaborate closely with the data team and company-wide stakeholders. As we continue to grow the business, you will scale marketing-focused insights and lead new data-driven initiatives.

  • Apply various analytics methods to gain insights into all aspects of marketing, including multi-touch attribution modeling, predictive lead scoring, paid media ROI analytics (MMM and iROAS) and full funnel pipeline reporting.

More about you

  • Strong verbal and communication skills. You can articulate why something should be built a certain way and how it will impact the business.

  • You expedite projects forward, favoring rapid and incremental development in parallel with problem-solving short-term obstacles.

  • You employ a structured approach to handle ambiguous exploratory analysis, balancing thoroughness with the MVP mindset.

  • You use data to achieve ambitious goals and influence company-level outcomes. Experience as a technical lead or manager is a plus.

  • You use excellent judgment and sharp business and product instincts that allow you to prioritize.

Bonus

  • Experience with forecasting and predictive modeling.

  • Experience with operational tools and systems like Segment, Amplitude and Hubspot (or other CRM tools).

  • Experience with dbt, Fivetran or Census.

  • Experience in Python or R.

What's cool about the role

  • You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.

  • Competitive pay, equity and benefits. The base salary for this role in Brazil is $110,000 - $150,000.

  10. Keeps the on-ice Facility Engineer advised of the status of power generating, water production and wastewater treatment equipment and systems.
  11. Coordinates with the on-ice Facility Engineer on issues concerning power generation, water production and wastewater plant operation.
  12. Coordinates with the Utilities Supervisor to order repair and/or spare parts, maintenance parts, assemblies, tools and consumables.
  13. Maintains inventory to at least 95% accuracy.
  14. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position’s work activities.
  15. Provides appropriate safety training to employees and documents the training.
  16. Assists Utilities Supervisor in creating and monitoring annual budgets.
  17. Recruits and recommends personnel.
  18. Monitors employee performance.
  19. Evaluates job hazards and communicates information to staff verbally and in writing through various venues, including weekly and/or daily crew meetings.
  20. Interprets project tasking utilizing design drawings, specifications and diagrams.
  21. Handles confidential matters in accordance with management policy and with the highest degree of professionalism.
  22. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with their subordinates as needed to relay information they need in order to be successful in their jobs.
  23. May be required to work outside on various jobsites in extreme cold weather and environmentally challenging conditions.

  25. Participates in dormitory chores while deployed to Antarctica.
  26. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. BA/BS required. Equivalent relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
  2. Minimum two (2) years supervisory experience in operation and maintenance of diesel engine power plants is required.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Mechanical aptitude with the ability to handle multiple tasks at once is required.
  2. Thorough knowledge of the principles and practices applied in the maintenance and repair of diesel electric generating equipment is required.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the methods, hazards, and safety precautions related to diesel engines and diesel engine driven electric generators is required.
  4. Ability to maintain a professional attitude and to work efficiently in a stressful environment is required.
  5. Working comprehension of electrical distribution, control panels and medium voltage switchgear.
  6. Intermediate skill level with Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel is required, high skill level is preferred.

Preferred:

  1. Previous experience with remote Polar Logistics operations is preferred.
  2. Experience with desalinization plants and associated equipment, or wastewater treatment plants is preferred.
  3. State issued licenses in water plants and/or wastewater treatment plants is preferred.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.

description:

As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

The Systems Engineer with a focus on Hardware Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of complete systems integrating Clever Devices hardware products with complementary technologies to deliver robust and reliable solutions that meet customer requirements. This role involves the design of high-quality cable harnesses, component mounting solutions, and the validation of physical and manufacturing requirements, including safety, structural integrity, vibration, thermal performance, shielding, and operational efficiency.

The Systems Engineer works closely with project teams to analyze customer requirements and define functionality early in the project lifecycle. Responsibilities include creating design documents, system architecture, requirement matrices, and supporting customer design reviews. Additionally, the Systems Engineer oversees Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and System Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring successful system deployment at customer sites. The position requires collaboration with cross-functional teams such as Program Management, Product Management, Hardware Engineering, and Systems Engineering to deliver tailored solutions for the transit industry.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead system design, integration, and deployment, ensuring compliance with safety, structural, and operational standards.
  • Design and validate cable harnesses, component mounting solutions, and other hardware to meet form, fit, and function requirements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design drawings, schematics, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and installation instructions.
  • Conduct and review detailed analyses, acceptance test procedures, installation procedures, and operating procedures using relevant software tools.
  • Oversee system integration, FAT, and SAT processes, ensuring all phases of deployment meet customer expectations.
  • Manage and document system configurations while performing performance and reliability analyses for end-to-end protocols.
  • Supervise and train staff or contractors involved in retrofitting and installing Clever Devices equipment at customer locations.
  • Review and verify technical documentation to ensure correctness and accuracy in design outputs.
  • Support fast-paced, dynamic team environments, maintaining a focus on cost-effectiveness and manufacturability.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (required); Master’s degree preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data, and communication technologies.
  • Expertise in hardware design, including reading and interpreting electrical schematics.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience with 2D/3D CAD tools (e.g., Zuken E3, SolidWorks, AutoCAD); experience in cable harnessing and sheet metal is a plus.
  • Familiarity with J1939 and J1708 protocols and heavy vehicle wiring systems (e.g., transit buses or rail) is advantageous.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting, lab equipment, and network/protocol diagnostic tools.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, SQL) and report generation.

Capabilities:

  • Strong problem-solving skills, multitasking ability, and a creative approach to technical challenges.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on clarity and precision.
  • Ability to independently gather, document, and interpret technical requirements.

Physical Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel domestically at least (25%).
  • Ability to operate computer peripherals and view display terminals for extended periods.
  • Capable of lifting or pulling up to 15 pounds.

O Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial – Departamento Regional de Santa Catarina torna pública a presente Chamada para Seleção de Bolsistas e convoca os interessados a se candidatarem, conforme os critérios aqui estabelecidos.

Nível de formação: Graduado, Mestrado em andamento ou Mestrado completo.
Formação: Química, Biotecnologia, Ciências Farmacêuticas ou áreas correlatas.

Requisitos Necessarios:

  1. Análises químicas e instrumentação analítica (ex.: cromatografia, espectrometria de massas).
  2. Desenvolvimento e caracterização de extratos vegetais.
  3. Técnicas analíticas aplicadas à química de produtos naturais.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  1. Experiência com extratos vegetais e técnicas analíticas avançadas.
  2. Familiaridade com softwares de análise química e estatística.
  3. Conhecimento em metodologias de validação analítica.

Será um diferencial:

  1. Experiência em desenvolvimento de métodos para análise de compostos bioativos.
  2. Conhecimento em técnicas de metabolômica e/ou proteômica aplicada.
  3. Publicações ou participação em projetos nestas áreas.

Descrição e Objetivos do Projeto de PD&I:
O projeto visa caracterizar extratos vegetais de modo a identificar novos ingredientes a serem usados na cadeia produtiva da carne cultivada. Para isso, tecnologias de instrumentação analítica serão utilizadas nas caracterizações.

Os objetivos principais do projeto são:

  1. Apoiar na obtenção de extratos vegetais;
  2. Realizar análises químicas em instrumentos analíticos;
  3. Reportar os resultados obtidos em forma de relatório.

Área Tecnológica predominante no projeto: Biotecnologia

Título do Plano de Trabalho: Obtenção e caracterização de extratos vegetais.

Systems Engineer (Data Science Focus)

The Systems Engineer with a focus on Data Science is responsible for leading the deployment of integrated systems that include Clever Devices products and complementary technologies, delivering solutions tailored to customer requirements. This role combines expertise in systems engineering and data science to deploy hardware products, interfaces, and data-driven insights that enhance customer operations. The Systems Engineer collects, cleans, and analyzes transit-related data, applying advanced statistical techniques and machine learning models to provide actionable recommendations and optimize system performance.

The engineer collaborates closely with project teams to analyze customer needs, create design documents, system architecture, and requirement matrices, and support customer design reviews. Responsibilities also include conducting Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), System Acceptance Testing (SAT), and managing system development, integration, and configuration documentation.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of systems integrating hardware, software, and data technologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data-driven solutions into Clever Devices’ Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) platform.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in statistical programming (Python, R, MATLAB, or SAS).
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with statistical techniques, data mining methods, and machine learning algorithms.
  • Experience with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project).
  • Knowledge of J1939 and J1708 protocols, with familiarity in hardware troubleshooting.

Capabilities:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret customer data and translate it into actionable insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage internal teams and external customers.

  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to influence stakeholders and drive operational improvements.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

The Senior Product Manager role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities and acumen. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable assessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with key business stakeholders and multiple partners to envision what will make Seller Listing experiences a success and shape analytical deliverables. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by the ambiguity or competing priorities to scale in different geographies. This means you are not only able to own high-level strategic initiatives, but also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Owning, building and driving the seller experience with key local and global stakeholders such as tech, legal, accounting, and operations.
  2. Manage prioritization and trade-offs to ensure the right features are built with the right quality at the right time.
  3. Driving decision making throughout the team.
  4. Partnering with global product teams to identify and influence development of new products and services.
  5. Addressing barriers through problem solving and coordination with stakeholders.
  6. Gain support for your strategy and roadmap from stakeholders by writing narratives and influencing peers and senior leadership.
  7. Creating goals and related metrics, track progress and manage through obstacles to achieve your objectives.
  8. Communicating performance, articulating root-cause analysis and linking to specific improvement areas.
  9. Incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class seller experience.

About the team

Inclusive and Diverse: We embrace our differences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, reminding members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance: We believe striking the balance between personal and professional life is critical to life-long fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours so you find your own balance.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We believe supporting new members is critical for team-wide success. We celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. As Irmãs realizam sua missão nos continentes: americano, europeu e africano, presentes na Albânia, Benin, Brasil, Canadá, Inglaterra, Itália, México e Suíça. No Brasil, atuam em nove estados: Bahia, Brasília, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Tocantins.

Há mais de 60 anos, a Congregação é responsável pelo Santa Marcelina Saúde composto pela rede de 7 hospitais (Porto Velho-RO, Sapezal-MT, Itaquaquecetuba-SP, Cidade Tiradentes-SP, Itaim Paulista-SP, Itaquera-SP e São Bernardo do Campo-SP) e mais de 140 serviços de Atenção Primária à Saúde localizados na região leste do município de São Paulo. Tornou-se uma importante referência na prestação de serviços e pela atuação nos diferentes níveis de atenção à saúde, por meio do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), Convênios e Particulares.

description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Pipefitter will perform maintenance or construction welding tasking, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the Plumbing Foreman. Tasking is based on employee’s prior work experience and ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform pipe welding and structural welding tasks on maintenance and construction projects.
  2. Perform cutting, fitting/welding, connection, and installation of piping.
  3. Weld various types and sizes of piping, using multi-process techniques.
  4. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  5. Accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  6. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  7. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  8. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), suggest revisions as needed, and create SOPs as directed.
  9. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  10. Use solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  11. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  12. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  13. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  14. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).
  15. Occasionally utilize the assistance of other station personnel to complete tasking, or assist other trades or departments with their tasking.
  16. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  17. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.
  18. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.
  19. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Previous 6G welding certification at time of hire.
  3. Must pass a 6G welding certification exam prior to deployment.
  4. Minimum 4 years’ experience in pipe fitting and pipe welding work.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.
  2. Experience in construction and/or maintenance of commercial and/or industrial facilities.
  3. Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.
  4. Possess the competencies, willingness and ability to perform the duties of position.

Preferred:

  1. Experience working with a variety of pipe materials.
  2. Brazing experience.
  3. Rigging experience.
  4. Prior cold weather welding experience.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary

Functions as part of the clinical team providing clinical care under the direction of an LPN, RN, or provider. Assists with administrative, clinical, and clerical duties which could include taking a patient's history and personal information, scheduling appointments, responding to patient communications, and rooming patients.


Job Duties
  • Prepares patient and equipment for exams/procedures and maintains exam rooms and clinical area.
  • Performs medical history collection and medication refill, per protocol.
  • Collects and prepares lab specimens/lab requisitions accurately and schedules and obtains authorizations for referrals and/or procedures.
  • Identifies actual or potential patient risks and communicates those risks to the licensed nurse or provider upon recognition.
  • Adheres to clerical, clinical, and EMR workflows.
  • Performs clerical duties and provides front office support duties such as greeting and welcoming patients and providing excellent customer service both in-person and over the phone.
  • Collects co-payments, schedules appointments, updates missing patient demographics, obtains referrals and pre-certifications.
  • Uses patient centered care concepts in delivering care and performing related activities.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Specialized Diploma as a Medical Assistant
  • Ability to accept and adapt to constant change within a healthcare setting.
  • Ability to take initiative and function independently as well as collaboratively.
  • Excellent computer skills including EMR, word processing, and Excel.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree from a Medical Assistant Program
  • CCMA - Certified Clinical Medical Assistant - NHA - State of Pennsylvania or
  • CMA - Certified Medical Assistant - AAMA - State of Pennsylvania or
  • CMAC - Clinical Medical Assistant Certification - AMCA - State of Pennsylvania or
  • MAC - Medical Assistant Certified - AMCA - State of Pennsylvania or
  • NCMA - National Certified Medical Assistant - NCTT - State of Pennsylvania or
  • NRCMA - National Registered Certified Medical Assistant - NAHP - State of Pennsylvania or
  • RMA - Registered Medical Assistant AMT - State of Pennsylvania

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Refrigeration Mechanic
description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Refrigeration Mechanics perform refrigeration repair and maintenance on maintenance and construction projects, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the Preventative Maintenance Foreman. Tasking is based on ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on refrigeration and cooling equipment in accordance with the preventive maintenance program. This includes installation and startup of refrigeration and cooling equipment utilizing special tools and equipment.
  2. Diagnose, repair, and perform scheduled Preventative Maintenance on existing refrigeration systems and equipment.
  3. Effectively communicate with affected parties regarding planned tasking, issues, or impacts.
  4. Advise the Preventive Maintenance Foreman on job progress and material/labor requirements.
  5. Maintain up to date refrigeration inventory.
  6. Assist Facilities Maintenance Supervisor and PM Foreman in determining materials for inventory re-supply.
  7. Order replacement parts as needed.
  8. Act as EPA required “Refrigerant Manager” for CFC tracking, leak detection, and reporting functions.
  9. Work with all electrical components from disconnect throughout equipment.
  10. Submit reports as required by supervisor.
  11. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  12. Accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  13. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  14. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  15. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and create or revise SOPs as needed.
  16. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  17. Use solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  18. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  19. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  20. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  21. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).
  22. Occasionally utilize the assistance of other station personnel to complete tasking, or assist other trades or departments with their tasking.
  23. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  24. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.
  25. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.
  26. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in refrigeration mechanic work, including installation and maintenance of refrigeration equipment.
  • Current EPA Section 608 Universal Technician Certification.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  • Ability to diagnose, maintain, adjust, repair, and replace refrigeration systems and components.
  • Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.
  • Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.
  • Possess the competencies, willingness, and ability to perform the duties of the position.

Preferred:

  • Experience in commercial and/or industrial facilities.
  • HVAC/R license/certification.
  • Experience with Maximo or other Computerized Maintenance Management System.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  • Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  • Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  • Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  • Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  • Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  • Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  • Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.
  • Valid Driver’s License issued in the United States.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location.

title: Power Plant Technician
description:
Responsibilities:

  1. Maintains a safe workplace program and ensures that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Complies with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements, goals, policies and procedures. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  3. Provides uninterrupted medium voltage electrical service while operating to the highest standards.
  4. Monitors Power Plant parameters and makes necessary adjustments to ensure operations are within established guidelines.
  5. Monitors diesel engine/generators and associated switch gear parameters.
  6. Monitors waste heat recovery system, wind turbine production and auxiliary equipment parameters.
  7. Makes adjustments to diesel engine/generators and auxiliary systems to ensure Power Plant is operating with the highest level of efficiency and reliability possible. Monitors and makes adjustments to power distribution system by adding and removing feeders as required.
  8. Maintains operating logbooks and databases as required.
  9. Starts, places in service and secures diesel generators as necessary.
  10. Maintains identified operational hours spread of diesel engine/generators to better forecast maintenance.
  11. Responds to unscheduled equipment failures with appropriate immediate and subsequent actions while on shift.
  12. Assists the Power Plant Mechanic with scheduled maintenance and repairs.
  13. Maintains cleanliness of Power Plant facilities including diesel engines.
  14. Advises the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative of the status of power production equipment and systems.
  15. Works a rotating shift; day, swing or night shift.
  16. Trains Power Plant Operators on mechanical equipment as directed.
  17. Complies with applicable Safety, Environment, Health, and Waste Management policies and procedures.
  18. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position’s work activities.
  19. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with their superiors and peers as needed to relay information they need in order to be successful in their jobs. This includes, but is not limited to, staff meetings, performance appraisals, job requirements, division metrics, projects, Quality Standard Procedures, and safety practices.
  20. May be required to work outside on various jobsites in extreme cold weather and environmentally challenging conditions.
  21. Interacts with other partner companies, the National Science Foundation, military and other agency officials, both over the telephone and in person. Is kind, courteous, cooperative and professional at all times.
  22. Participates in dormitory chores while deployed to Antarctica.
  23. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Minimum 2 years Power Plant experience required (Diesel, Gas Turbine, Nuclear, Hydroelectric or Renewable). Equivalent experience in diesel engine or electrical maintenance accepted in lieu of Power Plant experience.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Mechanical aptitude with the ability to handle multiple tasks at once is required.
  2. Working knowledge of the principles and practices applied in the operation of diesel electric generating equipment is required.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the methods, hazards, and safety precautions related to diesel engines and diesel engine driven electric generators is required.
  4. Ability to maintain a professional attitude and to work efficiently in a stressful environment is required.
  5. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

Preferred:

  1. High school graduate or GED.
  2. Previous experience with remote Polar Logistics operations.
  3. Diesel Power generation experience.
  4. Strong background in diesel engine and electrical troubleshooting.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

title: Power Plant Electrician
description:
Job Responsibilities:

  1. Maintains a safe workplace program and ensures that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Complies with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements, goals, policies and procedures. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  3. Performs preventive maintenance and repair on all switchgear control circuits, generators, contactors and relays in accordance with procedures and manufacturers’ recommendations.
  4. Tests and repairs all safety circuits in generator and control units.
  5. Inspects electrical power generation systems to ensure that no faults exist.
  6. Monitors operation of all power generation electrical components to ensure proper operation.
  7. Monitors loading; operates power generation equipment in an efficient and economical manner.
  8. Completes maintenance records and maintains operating logbooks as required; documents all maintenance performed.
  9. Coordinates with the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative to order repair and/or spare parts, maintenance parts, assemblies, tools and consumables.
  10. Advises the Utilities Supervisor or their on-site representative of the status of power production stock, equipment and systems.
  11. Maintains control of Power Plant Electrician's tools and manuals.
  12. Maintains inventory accuracy at 98% or better.
  13. Trains Power Plant Operators and Mechanics on Power Plant operation and equipment as directed.
  14. Ability to cover Power Plant Operator shift/rounds as required.
  15. Supports the achievement of metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position’s work activities.
  16. Works to achieve goals and contractual commitments.
  17. Troubleshoots and repairs electrical problems.
  18. Willingness to work a rotating shift: day, swing or night shift.
  19. Responds to power outages and equipment failures as required.
  20. Evaluates job hazards and communicates information to staff verbally and in writing through various venues, including weekly and/or daily crew meetings.
  21. Interprets project tasking utilizing design drawings, specifications and diagrams.
  22. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with their superiors and peers as needed to relay information they need in order to be successful in their jobs.
  23. May be required to work outside on various jobsites in extreme cold weather and environmentally challenging conditions.
  24. Interacts with other partner companies, the National Science Foundation, military and other agency officials, both over the telephone and in person. Is kind, courteous, cooperative and professional at all times.
  25. Participates in dormitory chores while deployed to Antarctica.
  26. Performs other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. A current Journeyman Electrician license, a current Master Electrician license, or equivalent Union membership in good standing. A Journeyman license requiring less than 8,000 hours or of the Residential type shall not be considered.
  3. Minimum four years (8,000 Hours) documented experience in all phases of electrical work, with at least 2 of those years being in power distribution wiring, directly related power plant/electrical switchgear and control panel maintenance and repair.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read design drawings and wiring diagrams is required.
  2. Mechanical aptitude with the ability to handle multiple tasks at once is required.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the methods, hazards, and safety precautions related to diesel engines and diesel engine driven electric generators is required.
  4. Ability to maintain a professional attitude and to work efficiently in a stressful environment is required.
  5. Working comprehension of electrical distribution, control panels and medium voltage switchgear.
  6. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

Preferred:

  1. Previous experience with remote Polar Logistics operations is preferred.
  2. Experience working with AC and DC voltages from 12 up to 4160 is preferred.
  3. Mechanical, construction, or other industrial experience is preferred.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.
  8. Valid Driver’s License

title: Home Health Aide
description:
Discover Rewarding Work as a Home Health Aide:

Are you looking for a meaningful career, where you can make a difference in the lives of others—and yours as well?

At BAYADA, we seek people who share our passion for caring and are committed to helping people live their best lives at home. As a member of our personal care and companionship team, you will do truly meaningful work—and be valued, respected, and heard. While you support clients one-on-one with activities of daily living, we’ll support you with training, flexibility, and a team dedicated to creating a great employee experience. We are currently recruiting for a Home Health Aide (HHA) to reliably serve our clients.

Counties we Serve

  • Wayne
  • Pike
  • Monroe
  • Carbon
  • North Hampton
  • Schuylkill
  • Lehigh
  • Bucks
  • Berk

What you’ll do:

  • Following a written plan of care by a registered nurse, you’ll provide personal care services, household support, and companion care (homemaker) services to help adults stay safe and independent at home.

As a BAYADA Home Health Aide you’ll have the opportunity to develop close relationships with your clients while you help them with:

  • Activities of daily living: bathing, grooming, toileting, nail care, etc.
  • Household support: light housekeeping, laundry, bed making etc.
  • Meal preparation and feeding
  • Range of motion/exercises
  • Assisting with ambulation (Transfers/use of mechanical lifting devices)
  • Medication reminders

What makes you a great candidate:

  • Previous home health care or patient care welcomed, but not required. We will train you.
  • A passion for caregiving and a desire to help others.
  • A commitment to being present and providing quality care.
  • Empathy, patience, kindness, and respect.
  • Ability to travel to clients’ homes as assigned.
  • The commitment to deliver patient care as you would want those you love to be treated, with compassion, excellence, and reliability – The BAYADA Way.

Why you’ll love what you do at BAYADA

As a mission-driven, not-for-profit organization, we are committed to providing patients with the highest-quality care, enabling them to live safely at home with comfort, independence, and dignity. And we are just as dedicated to your satisfaction and success. 89% of employees say they are proud to work for BAYADA!

As a BAYADA Home Health Aide you’ll enjoy:

  • Weekly pay
  • Flexible schedules for work/life balance: full-time, part-time, per-diem, and on-call.
  • PTO and benefits offerings as eligible
  • Career advancement support including ongoing training and scholarships

description:
Apply

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture, including database administration and solutions, in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience architecting solutions for data transformation, migration, governance strategies, high availability, or disaster recovery.
  • Experience working with Databases, Web Technologies, Machine Learning, AI, or Cloud Foundations (e.g., cloud computing, GCP, or similar) through certifications, internships, coursework, or practical experience.
  • Ability to communicate fluently in Portuguese and English to engage and present to technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with optimizing database performance with transactional or analytic workloads.
  • Experience in disaster recovery and data backup strategies.
  • Experience with data migration strategies and moving production systems either in on-premise/data center environments or migration to cloud scenarios.
  • Experience in understanding customers existing software workloads, with the ability to define a technical migration roadmap to the Cloud reflecting specific customer needs.
  • Experience prospecting, building, and maintaining customer relationships, with an interest in building Greenfield territories in Enterprise accounts.

About the Job:

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer, you will partner with Technical Sales teams as a data management subject matter expert to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will help prospective and existing customers and partners understand the power of Google Cloud, develop creative cloud solutions and architectures to solve their business challenges, engage in proofs of concepts, and troubleshoot any technical questions and roadblocks related to database and application migrations and data back ends for new application development. You will engage with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems

title: Sheetmetal Worker
description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Sheetmetal Worker performs sheetmetal metal fabrication, assembly, and installation tasks on maintenance or construction projects, or any combination thereof. Tasking is based on ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform sheet metal fabrication, assembly and installation on maintenance and construction projects.

  2. Perform layout and fabrication of ductwork and building components, using mechanical fasteners or welding.

  3. Perform a variety of sheetmetal fabrications for heating and ventilation systems and building components using a variety of sheetmetal forming tools and equipment.

  4. Assist with insulation projects as required.

  5. Respond timely to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.

  6. Document hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved accurately and thoroughly.

  7. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.

  8. Accomplish tasks working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.

  9. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and create or revise SOPs as needed.

  10. Perform tasks outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.

  11. Use sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.

  12. Identify unsafe conditions or hazards proactively and communicate them effectively.

  13. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasks.

  14. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.

  15. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).

  16. Utilize assistance from other station personnel to complete tasks, or assist other trades or departments with their tasks.

  17. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.

  18. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.

  19. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.

  20. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates, and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.

  2. Minimum four years of documented experience in all phases of sheetmetal fabrication and assembly.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.

  2. Prior computer experience and willingness to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.

  3. Competencies, willingness, and ability to perform the duties of the position.

Preferred:

  1. Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Contractors' National Association License, or equivalent.

  2. Experience in a commercial or industrial environment.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.

  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.

  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.

  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.

  5. Ability to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.

  6. Ability to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold.

  7. Participation in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

  8. Valid Driver’s License issued in the United States.

  9. Ability to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location.

description:
Se você é apaixonado por cuidar de pessoas e quer fazer a diferença em uma Instituição com mais de 4 mil pessoas atuando nas áreas de saúde, educação e responsabilidade social, essa é a sua oportunidade!

O Nutricionista Clínico é responsável pela atenção nutricional integral ao paciente, incluído o diagnóstico, definição do plano terapêutico nutricional, o monitoramento da alimentação na internação, e o processo de educação nutricional para continuidade do cuidado, visando manter ou recuperar o estado nutricional dos pacientes internados ou ambulatoriais, de todos os setores do Hospital Santa Ana, sempre em consonância com a Missão, Visão e Valores éticos, morais e humanos, fundamentados nos valores da Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo Scalabrinianas.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a atenção nutricional integral ao paciente por meio da avaliação nutricional, do diagnóstico, da prescrição da dietoterapia, da recomendação de técnicas dietéticas, e do seguimento terapêutico ao longo da internação;
  • Conduzir as ações de educação nutricional por meio do aconselhamento de pacientes, familiares e cuidadores, da preparação para o autocuidado domiciliar, do desenvolvimento de atividades de ensino, pesquisa, controle e análise do desempenho assistencial;
  • Controlar o estoque de insumos e correlatos necessários para o plano nutricional do paciente, por meio de adoção de inventários, do controle de prazos e validades, do descarte adequado, e da aplicação de técnicas de segurança alimentar e vigilância nutricional;
  • Preservar a integridade do paciente mediante a adoção e o cumprimento de processos de qualidade e segurança, da ética profissional, dos protocolos institucionais, dos procedimentos operacionais técnicos (POT), da vigilância em saúde, da Política HumanizaSUS e do acompanhamento dos indicadores assistenciais e de resultado;
  • Assegurar os registros nutricionais por meio do relato das ações de cuidados e procedimentos do plano dietético, e da supervisão das informações e procedimentos executados pelas equipes multiprofissionais;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e supervisão de estagiários de nutrição.

Requisitos

  • Curso Superior em Nutrição;
  • Desejável especialização em nutrição clínica e/ou paciente crítico/UTI;
  • Desejável experiência no setor/área de atuação.

Benefícios

  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Seguro de vida MetLife;
  • Teleatendimento em saúde mental 24h, extensivo a familiares.

Sobre a AESC

Fundada em 1962, a AESC tem sua origem na Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo-Scalabrinianas, presentes no Rio Grande do Sul desde 1915, e que aqui se estabeleceram com o propósito de acolher e cuidar, de modo particular, pessoas migrantes fragilizadas na sua condição socioeconômica e cultural, desde seus países e localidades de origem.

Hoje somos mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras nos segmentos de educação, saúde e responsabilidade social.

Nossa unidade de responsabilidade social está presente na cidade de Caxias do Sul, com o Centro de Atendimento ao Migrante.

Nossas unidades de educação estão presentes nas cidades de Farroupilha, Colégio Nossa Senhora de Lourdes, em Caxias do Sul, Colégio São Carlos, e em Santa Vitória do Palmar, Colégio São Carlos.

E nossas unidades de saúde estão presentes nas cidades de Porto Alegre, com hospitais e serviços de referência no RS e no Brasil, Hospital Mãe de Deus, Hospital Santa Ana e Centros de Atenção Psicossocial. Na cidade de Capão da Canoa, Hospital Santa Luzia, e na cidade de Torres, Hospital Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes.

title: Assistente de Campo - Boa Vista/RR - RR
description:
A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, qualificada como Organização da Sociedade Civil de Interesse Público (OSCIP), constituída em 2007 para atuar com iniciativas de promoção do desenvolvimento de pessoas. Nasceu da experiência de profissionais vinculados à Fundação AVSI ( os quais tinham o desejo de poder contribuir para seu crescimento no país. Esta estratégia permitiu que se reportasse, ao âmbito da AVSI Brasil, a motivação ideal, a riqueza curricular de colaboradores da Fundação e a experiência de projetos em diferentes áreas de atuação, trazendo, porém, o protagonismo e a responsabilidade de sujeitos brasileiros.

Cumprindo sua missão de tornar as pessoas em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, a AVSI Brasil implementa projetos sociais construídos a partir de uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, com vistas à melhoria da condição de vida e alcance da autonomia. Nos últimos anos, a Venezuela tem vivido uma forte crise, ocasionando vulnerabilidade social e um contexto de emergência humanitária que se concretiza em uma intensa migração em território brasileiro.

Em 2018, como resposta a essa demanda, o Governo Federal estruturou a Operação Acolhida cujo objetivo é garantir atendimento aos refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos. A operação consiste em uma série de estratégias de regularização documental, imunização, acolhimento e realocação voluntária dessas pessoas, em situação de vulnerabilidade, dos municípios de Roraima para outras cidades do Brasil. A AVSI Brasil integra a resposta federal à emergência humanitária venezuelana da Operação Acolhida, e neste contexto formalizou um Termo de Colaboração com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social (MDS) para atuar em 4 (quatro) centros de acolhida (abrigos) para refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos na cidade de Boa Vista, em Roraima.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Assistente de Campo reporta ao(à) Coordenador de Abrigo. Sua atribuição é apoiar atividades gerais da gestão de abrigos, nas áreas de coordenação, proteção, registro, distribuição e logística, infraestrutura, participação comunitária, interiorização, proteção de base comunitária, dentre outras, conforme atribuição do(a) supervisor.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

Coordenação:

  1. Apoiar o(a) coordenador(a) com a comunicação com a equipe, parceiros e comunidade.
  2. Apoiar no preenchimento de planilhas e documentos diversos.

Distribuição e Logística:

  1. Apoiar o Assistente de Distribuição no preparo de relatórios e atualização dos sistemas de distribuição.
  2. Apoiar na comunicação com a comunidade sobre entrega de itens alimentares e não alimentares.
  3. Dar suporte ao Assistente de Distribuição e propor formas para aumentar o engajamento da população do abrigo e de melhorar os procedimentos de distribuição.
  4. Apoiar o monitoramento e avaliação das distribuições, incluindo um acompanhamento pós-distribuição, com a agência responsável.
  5. Apoiar na distribuição de itens não alimentares.
  6. Apoiar no controle de estoque: atualização da planilha, organização do espaço físico, contagem de materiais.
  7. Apoiar no recebimento de itens não alimentares e materiais diversos.

Participação Comunitária:

  1. Apoiar o Oficial de Participação Comunitária no acompanhamento e fortalecimento dos comitês, assembleias e outros grupos de organização comunitária.
  2. Auxiliar na organização dos comitês da comunidade, na mobilização da população, na preparação dos espaços físicos para as reuniões, na condução das reuniões.

  7. Apoiar na coleta de dados para a produção de relatórios (fotografias, lista de presença etc).
  8. Apoiar nas atividades de proteção de base comunitária.

Registro:
